query:
UPDATE holds
            SET expires_at = CASE
                    WHEN extended_at IS NULL
                    THEN GREATEST(expires_at, now() + make_interval(secs => $3))
                    ELSE expires_at
                END,
                extended_at = COALESCE(extended_at, now())
            WHERE hold_id = $1
              AND owner_id = $2
              AND (status = 'confirmed' OR expires_at > now())
            RETURNING expires_at
